text:
Jamal (Partnerships): tossing an operational play to the channel: how do we structure marketplace private-offers for HW+SI with usage floors, a gradual ramp guarantee, and an "emergency decommit" clause for customers who massively under-consume? want predictable partner payouts and clean finance reconciles.
Pri (Sales): practical asks: 1) simple language for customers: "commit + monthly vesting credits"; 2) ramp guarantee: customer can get a reduced churn exposure if they hit 40% of commit in month1, 60% in month2, 80% by month3; 3) emergency decommit should be 1-time and require 30d notice + usage audit.
Tao (Finance): finance constraints: all seller credits must be ledgered monthly and have GL tags. propose: have two buckets - "vested_provisional" and "released_payout". emergency decommit triggers a reconciliation flow that calculates net owed = committed_paid - actual_usage_value - clawback_penalty. Need a 120d reversal window for refunds.
Rhea (Field Ops): ops notes: milestone gating is key. recommend automated ramp-check webhooks (monthly) plus a manual audit step for decommit requests. for SI payouts, escrow monthly and release 14d after milestone signal to allow refunds. include an on-demand report for AMs: projected payout vs. withheld.
Nate (Eng-Billing): infra plan: extend private-offer metadata with fields: "usage_floor_profile", "ramp_schedule", "emergency_decommit_policy", "seller_split", "escrow_ttl_days". we'll emit usage events with offer_id + line_id + seller_tag so attribution is deterministic. created ticket INF-4120 to track.
ops-bot: INF-4120 created - "usage-floor + ramp schedule + emergency decommit handling" assigned to eng-billing.
Jamal (Partnerships): sketch of policy language I want in docs:
````
policy_summary:
- Commit term: 12 months, monthly billing
- Usage floor: customer agrees to >=50% of monthly commit in first 3 months, or pays shortfall fee equal to X% of difference
- Ramp guarantee: progressive thresholds (month1 40%, month2 60%, month3 80%) with waiver if validated deployment delays recorded in Console
- Emergency decommit: 30d notice + field audit. decommit settlement = committed_paid_to_date - usage_value - 10% admin clawback on remaining escrow. one-time per contract.
- Seller payout: monthly vesting into escrow; release after milestone verification (14d hold)
- Reversals: negative-usage window 120d
````
Pri (Sales): two proposed commercial levers: 1) buy-down option: customer can prepay 3 months at discounted rate to waive emergency decommit penalties for that window, 2) residency discount for private deployments (VPC/on-prem) where we offer extra 3% list discount due to higher operational cost for us.
Tao (Finance): prepay must be recorded as deferred revenue and applied against committed drawdown. residency discount should have explicit margin floor guardrails. add reconciliation export columns: offer_id, month, committed_paid, actual_usage_value, shortfall_fee, escrow_withheld, escrow_released, decommit_settlement, gl_code.
Rhea (Field Ops): operational checklist for launch: 1) automated ramp smoke tests (health + token traffic), 2) deployment delay flag in Console, 3) decommit intake form + audit runbook, 4) webhook to AMs when shortfall >10% for 2 consecutive months.
Nate (Eng-Billing): implementation steps: 1) add offer metadata fields and usage event attributes, 2) ledger provisional entries and escrow state, 3) API endpoint POST /escrow/settle for decommit settlements, 4) webhook channel for ramp/shortfall alerts. I'll open subtask INF-4120-1 for the settlement endpoint.
ops-bot: INF-4120-1 created - "escrow settlement endpoint + decommit calculation".
Jamal (Partnerships): ok owners: Pri -> pricing play + prepay copy; Tao -> reconciliation spec; Rhea -> ops intake & audit runbook; Nate -> infra + INF-4120 tracks. target: pilot with one HW partner + 2 SIs in 8 weeks.
Pri (Sales): will mock customer-facing private-offer snippet and a 1-pager for AMs.
Tao (Finance): will draft CSV schema for monthly reconciliation and sample ledger entries.
Rhea (Field Ops): will draft audit checklist and webhook payload examples.
Nate (Eng-Billing): RFC coming to #eng-billing next week.
Jamal (Partnerships): thanks team. pushing to get one clean example private-offer payload into the playbook so sales can run a demo. :rocket:
